metadata.title: Clifford-weighted residues, partial spectral curvature, and torsion
metadata.abstract: We study Clifford-weighted noncommutative residues associated with Dirac operators and connections. On closed spin manifolds a double commutator of the square of the Dirac operator, paired with a Clifford commutator, recovers the localized Riemann curvature tensor. We prove presentation independence for its extension to arbitrary classical one-forms, recompute four-Clifford functionals, and give explicit Weyl, Schouten and Einstein curvature combinations. For spectral triples with an admissible residue calculus we define a partial spectral curvature functional on two arbitrary represented one-forms and two exact represented one-forms. Its well-definedness is distinguished from module tensoriality: explicit flat noncommutative-torus computations exhibit both a failure of general presentation descent and nonzero partial pairings. A connection-based curvature pairing provides a separate construction, including noncentral pure Clifford-degree-two examples. We also derive ordered first- and second-derivative torsion residues on free torus modules and prove an obstruction to ordinary alternation for unrestricted noncentral inputs. All constants, coefficient orders and hypotheses are kept explicit.

analysis.progressType: 谱曲率构造与非交换障碍
analysis.workSummary: 在闭自旋流形上，以 Dirac 算子平方的双交换子配对 Clifford 交换子的非交换留数恢复局部 Riemann 曲率，证明延拓到一般经典一形式的表示无关性，并计算 Weyl、Schouten、Einstein 曲率组合。在具适用留数演算的谱三元组上，对两个一般表示一形式及两个恰当表示一形式定义部分谱曲率；平坦非交换环面计算揭示一般表示下降与模张量性的障碍。另给出联络曲率配对及自由环面模上有序一、二阶挠率导数留数。
analysis.breakthrough: 把经典曲率恢复与非交换推广的障碍分开，区分良定义、表示下降和模张量性。
analysis.limitations: 部分谱曲率限制两个输入为恰当形式，并非任意非交换 Riemann 曲率张量；无限制非中心输入还存在通常交替化的障碍。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。PDF 共 48 页已完成全文文本检索，页数一致、无短文本页，未检出作者使用生成式 AI 的披露；此状态仅指未观察到披露，不能据此断言未使用 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 谱几何基础工具有价值，但距比较几何和流的主线较远。
